annotation.authors_or_issuer: Civil Aviation Safety Authority (CASA), Australia; published via Federal Register of Legislation
key_provisions_or_claims: Grants area approval for RPA operations within 3 NM of controlled aerodromes at Canberra, Adelaide and Perth.
Operations must use a CASA-verified Drone Safety App.
Made under the Civil Aviation Safety Regulations 1998.
Registered as a notifiable instrument, F2022N00112, dated 15 May 2022.
annotation.summary_en: Australian CASA notifiable instrument (CASA 29/22) granting an area approval for remotely piloted aircraft operations within 3 NM of controlled aerodromes at Canberra, Adelaide and Perth, conditional on using a CASA-verified Drone Safety App. Made under the Civil Aviation Safety Regulations 1998; the page shows only metadata.
annotation.title_clean: CASA 29/22 – Area Approval for Operation of RPA within 3 NM of Controlled Aerodromes using CASA-verified Drone Safety App – Canberra (YSCB), Adelaide (YPAD) and Perth (YPPH) Instrument 2022
